subject.title: fix(ci): keep markdown-only PR jobs off Blacksmith

question: Should OpenClaw accept this early hosted `ci_scope` strategy for Markdown-only PR CI routing once the branch is rebased, or choose a different CI trigger/routing design?
rationale: The patch has good proof and preserves checks, but CI runner-routing policy affects required checks, runner capacity, and maintainer operations, and the canonical issue already carries a maintainer/product-decision signal.

options.title: Accept scope gate after rebase
options.body: Rebase this PR, preserve the hosted `ci_scope` design, rerun workflow guards plus exact-head CI proof, and land if the merged workflow remains clean.

options.title: Prefer trigger-level skipping
options.body: Close or supersede this PR with a narrower `paths-ignore` plus docs-workflow design, accepting the extra care needed to avoid suppressing security or docs checks.

options.title: Defer CI routing change
options.body: Keep the current Blacksmith behavior until maintainers choose a broader CI capacity strategy.

recommendation.title: Accept scope gate after rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR, preserve the hosted `ci_scope` design, rerun workflow guards plus exact-head CI proof, and land if the merged workflow remains clean.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history and blame connect this account most directly to CI workflow routing and guard-test maintenance for the affected files.
